rules.description: Patient SSN must not appear in plain text
rules.generic_fix: Redact or encrypt all SSN values before storing or transmitting the document.

rules.description: Date of birth should not be exposed in plain text
rules.generic_fix: Mask dates of birth or store them in an encrypted field.

rules.description: Patient consent / signature must be present
rules.generic_fix: Add an explicit patient consent and signature section.

rules.description: PHI encryption clause must be stated
rules.generic_fix: State that PHI is encrypted at rest and in transit (e.g. AES-256).

rules.description: Minimum necessary standard must be referenced
rules.generic_fix: Reference the HIPAA minimum necessary standard for PHI use and disclosure.

rules.description: Data sharing authorization must be documented
rules.generic_fix: Document the authorization basis for any PHI sharing.

rules.description: Breach notification clause must be present
rules.generic_fix: Add a breach notification clause with required timelines.

rules.description: Business associate agreement must be referenced
rules.generic_fix: Reference an executed Business Associate Agreement (BAA).

rules.description: Access control policy must be stated
rules.generic_fix: Describe role-based access controls for PHI.
Reference audit logging / audit trail controls.
State transmission security controls (TLS/SSL) for PHI in transit.

rules.description: De-identification must be referenced where applicable
rules.generic_fix: Reference de-identification procedures for secondary use of PHI.
